import json, os
from pathlib import Path
import torch, townlet
torch.set_num_threads(1)
assert Path(townlet.__file__).resolve() == Path('/workspace/hamlet/src/townlet/__init__.py')
assert torch.get_default_dtype() == torch.float32
rows=[]
for kind in (torch.optim.Adam, torch.optim.AdamW, torch.optim.RMSprop):
    p=torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))
    opt=kind([p], lr=0.0001)
    p.grad=torch.ones_like(p)
    opt.step()
    step=opt.state[p]['step']
    assert step.dtype == torch.float32 and step.device.type == 'cpu'
    step.fill_(2**24-1)
    values=[step.item()]
    for _ in range(2):
        p.grad=torch.ones_like(p)
        opt.step()
        values.append(step.item())
    assert values == [2**24-1, 2**24, 2**24], (kind.__name__,values)
    rows.append(dict(optimizer=kind.__name__, step_dtype=str(step.dtype), boundary_values=values))
print(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS CPU NUMERICAL PROBE',torch=torch.__version__,threads=torch.get_num_threads(),module=townlet.__file__,base=os.environ['BAC_QUAL_SHA'],candidate=os.environ['BAC_QUAL_TREE'],cases=rows,scope='Actual optimizer repeated-add representability near boundary; manually seeded step, not a 2**24-update training proof; CUDA unrun.')))
